labelling.pass_1: authored item, quote and key points directly from the source document text
labelling.pass_2: mechanical grounding check: every salient token of every key point must occur in the item's own evidence quotes
labelling.residual_detail: g-009: the source PDF renders 'beneficiaries' as 'benefi ciaries', so the key point cannot be token-matched against its own quote. Disclosed rather than reworded to force a pass.
labelling.disclosure: Author and reviewer are the same agent for gold items. Per EVAL_PROTOCOL.md §2.1 and U-17 this is SELF-AGREEMENT, not inter-rater reliability. No Cohen's kappa is reported here and none may be computed from these two passes. Human double-labelling under §5 is separately reported on 80 items in judge calibration (P0-1).

known_limits: Expanded to 35 documents and 425 gold items under P0-3, resolving C-3 and C-5 saturation.
ADR-0003 overlaps adjacent chunks by 150 characters, so a quote near a boundary resolves to two chunks and either is a correct citation. 399 citation IDs across 365 answerable items.
Deterministic metrics and calibrated judge run on all items; double-labelled subset provides human ground truth baseline.
